messages: Lina: quick design review — re: Stack Inspector header: can we move the Export action out of the overflow menu? users keep missing it. Tom: +1, overflow hides it. Where would you put it? next to Correlation ID copy? Lina: either next to corr id or as a primary action on the right. suggestion: change label from 'Export' to 'Export trace (.json)' so intent is explicit. Priya: note: product wants to A/B label text first — user testing will confirm. but we should fix keyboard order and aria while we iterate. Sam: from infra side we prefer it non-primary so it doesn't look like a destructive action. But accessibility-wise the control must be reachable via single Tab after details panel. Tom: agree on tabbable order. current DOM has Export after the overflow so Tab sequence skips it. easy fix: move export button earlier in DOM and visually keep it in menu via CSS. Lina: also copy tweak for correlation ID: 'Copy correlation ID' feels long — propose 'Copy ID'. but then tooltip should show full copy. thoughts? Priya: 'Copy ID' is OK if label contextually next to 'Correlation'. otherwise 'Copy correlation ID' for clarity in small screens. Sam: accessibility: when ID is copied, screen readers need announcement. currently we set a toast only. Need aria-live region for confirmation. A11yBot: suggestion: add role="status" aria-live="polite" to copy confirmation node. Also ensure contrast ratio for the toast text is >= 4.5:1. Tom: quick code example for the copy button I was thinking to push: ```html ``` Lina: looks good. one more thing: export modal title currently 'Trace export' — we should change to 'Export trace — include logs & spans' to make options clearer. Priya: product note: changing modal title might affect translations. file a small i18n ticket if we go forward. Sam: also performance note: large traces can exceed 10MB — add a warning line in the modal and a streaming-download option later. Lina: last nit: focus trap in export modal — after closing we should return focus to the Export button. currently it goes to top of page. Tom: I can add focus restore. will also ensure `aria-hidden` toggles on the background content. Lina: great — can we land the DOM reorder + aria-live + modal title change as a single PR? small copy changes can go in separate follow-up if needed. Priya: yes, consolidate into one PR and include a screenshot for QA. I'll create the A/B experiment ticket separately. Sam: tagging SRE for the large-download warning: @Sam (SRE) ping — actually that's me. I'll take the follow-up. Lina: thanks — I'll update the Figma and post a short QA checklist here when ready. :thumbsup: Tom: thanks — will start a branch after standup. A11yBot: reminder: include keyboard nav tests and an automated a11y check in the PR pipeline. Lina: noted. thanks everyone.
